purpose: Use the independently motivated circuit inductance scale near 1e-10 H to test whether the residual c2 remains necessary and/or becomes cross-day repeatable once L is prevented from drifting to fit-driven ~1e-8 H values.
guardrail: The external L scale is treated as an independent physical anchor, not as a fitted result. The 1x/3x/10x grid is a sensitivity test, not a confidence interval or claimed hardware tolerance. Magnicon is fixed to the documented nominal 10 kHz phase-normalized second-order Bessel form to avoid cutoff/c2 covariance. The current Connector Box LPF has been observed ON, but the 2024-12-05/06 measurement-time state remains unlogged. No production model is modified.
